name: War Winner
description:
This paint is given to the winners of the global «War» event. Actions in the «War» happen on the {GAME} world map. The owner of this paint is a very active tanker who is a good team player and knows how to apply good tactics.
The winner's paint is temporary. With the start of the next War with the map-voting system, it will be removed from the accounts of the current owners.
interestingFacts: This paint was obtained by the winning faction from the War. Stolen Christmas in December 2019 and in War 2025.
